row.evidence: Zoom's SCIM2 API reference lists as prerequisites a Business or Education account with an approved vanity URL and Single Sign-On enabled; the pricing page lists SSO from Business ($18.33/user/month billed annually).
row.notes: Pro rose from $13.33 to $14.16/user/mo billed annually ($16.99 monthly); Business stays $18.33 annual ($21.99 monthly), so the multiplier falls from 1.4 to 1.3. Status unchanged (gated). The pricing page lists SSO and managed domains on Business but does not mention SCIM; the Business gate comes from the SCIM2 API prerequisites (Business or Education plus approved vanity URL and SSO), hence medium confidence. Catalogue apps: Okta OIN (SCIM create/update/deactivate/group push), Entra gallery provisioning connector (OAuth 2.0), JumpCloud SCIM (Business, Enterprise; SSO required). Zoom's own pricing HTML is JS-rendered for browser user agents; quotes come from the server-rendered version.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: The Free plan has basic user API rate limits (50 user creations/day) but Create users requires Pro or higher.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: SCIM on Enterprise is implied (higher tier) but the SCIM2 prerequisites name only Business and Education accounts.

auth.token_source: Zoom App Marketplace OAuth or server-to-server OAuth app with the SCIM2 scope

operations.notes: Documented: GET/POST /scim2/Users, GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE /scim2/Users/{userId} (PATCH replaces active to activate/deactivate), GET/POST /scim2/Groups, GET/PATCH/DELETE /scim2/Groups/{groupId}.

deprovision.data_retained: Account remains in Zoom (deactivated); DELETE /scim2/Users/{userId} removes it.
deprovision.notes: frees_seat comes from the Users API description of deactivation (removes all licenses); the SCIM2 reference itself does not restate it.

custom.how: {customAttribute} key in the Zoom user extension maps to a Zoom custom attribute; the extension also carries licence/plan fields (zoomWorkplace, zoomPhoneCallingPlan, zoomPhoneNumber, zoomContactCenterPackage, zoomAICompanion and many more), personalLinkName, pronouns and transferee.

attributes.notes: Attribute names taken from the SCIM2 reference request/response schemas; Entra maps userName, active, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type eq "work"], enterprise department and userType.

roles.how: roles attribute (Zoom role names) on the user; userType sets the licence type (planned for deprecation in favour of plan fields).

rate_limits.text: SCIM2 endpoints carry Medium (list) and Light (create/update/delete) rate-limit labels; Business+ accounts get 80/s Light and 60/s Medium.

limitations.text: Requires a Business or Education account with an approved vanity URL and SSO enabled; calls fail with 'Account has not enabled Single Sign-On' otherwise.
Admin users cannot be deleted over SCIM.
Entra connector notes Zoom allows at most 9,999 basic users.

endpoints.purpose: Disassociate or permanently delete a user

rate_limits.text: Per plan: Free 4/s Light (6,000/day), Pro 30/s, Business+ 80/s for Light APIs; user creation capped at 1,500/day on Pro and 10,000/day on Business+.

user_api.notes: Endpoint paths copied from the Users API reference (.md export). An audit/activity-log API exists under the Accounts/Reports APIs but was not checked in this pass, so audit_log_api stays null. Licence assignment is via user type/plan fields on create/update and SCIM extension fields.

okta.notes: OIN marks SAML, OIDC, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push (plus Universal Logout and Workflows connectors); last updated Sep 16 2026.

entra.notes: Gallery provisioning connector (tenant URL https://api.zoom.us/scim, OAuth 2.0): create, remove, attribute sync.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud SCIM via the ZoomOAuth app; Business or Enterprise; SSO required first; removal deactivates but keeps the account. SAML JIT also supported.

fallbacks.notes: The Users API supports an ssoCreate action for SSO users, and JumpCloud documents SAML JIT for Zoom, but Zoom's own JIT/CSV support articles (support.zoom.com, JS-rendered) were not loaded.
